debt_items.title: Monolithic mcp-server.js File Size (119 KB / 2,491 lines)
debt_items.impact: Difficult maintenance, mixed concerns (routing, schemas, mock handlers, core dispatch).
debt_items.recommendation: Decompose into router, schema catalog, and modular handlers under src/mcp/handlers/.

debt_items.title: Dual Mission Runtime Implementations
debt_items.impact: MissionRuntime vs EOSOrchestrator maintain parallel state representations.
debt_items.recommendation: Consolidate into EOSOrchestrator as the single state machine.

debt_items.title: In-Memory Simulation Tools in Production MCP Server
debt_items.impact: Agent prompt bloat and hallucinated security assurance.
debt_items.recommendation: Segregate 22 simulation tools to eos-lab MCP server.

debt_items.title: Advisory Write Barrier vs Kernel-Level Enforcement
debt_items.impact: Agents can bypass barrier_check if writing via raw Node scripts outside MCP.
debt_items.recommendation: Wrap file modifications in guardrail-sandwich middleware.

debt_items.title: Dual Evidence Recording Interfaces
debt_items.recommendation: Deprecate eos.kernel.evidence in favor of physical file-sealing eos.evidence.record.
